title: Class-Conditional Conformal Triage for ICAO Face-Image Compliance under Class Imbalance: code and data
description: Code, per-image BioGaze outputs on the TONO synthetic dataset, result files and figures for the paper of the same title. A per-criterion classifier and a split conformal layer (marginal, Mondrian and randomised APS) are added to the rule-based BioGaze ICAO/ISO face-image compliance analyser and evaluated with subject-disjoint splits. Code under the MIT licence; data, results and figures under CC BY-NC 4.0 (derived from TONO).
